name: file_rename
description: Rename or move files and directories. Supports pattern-based batch renaming with preview mode.
author: octopus

params.command: python3 -c "import os,sys; src=sys.argv[1]; dst=sys.argv[2]; os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst) or '.', exist_ok=True); os.rename(src, dst); print(f'Renamed: {src} -> {dst}')" "{source_path}" "{target_path}"
